sn35.98:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you restraint and nonrestraint.
sn35.98:1.4: There are, bhikkhus, forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.98:1.5: If a bhikkhu seeks delight in them, welcomes them, and remains holding to them, he should understand this thus:
sn35.98:1.6: ‘I am declining away from wholesome states.
sn35.98:1.7: For this has been called decline by the Blessed One.’
sn35.98:1.8: “There are, bhikkhus, sounds cognizable by the ear …
sn35.98:1.9: mental phenomena cognizable by the mind that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.98:1.10: If a bhikkhu seeks delight in them, welcomes them, and remains holding to them, he should understand this thus:
sn35.98:1.11: ‘I am declining away from wholesome states.
sn35.98:1.12: For this has been called decline by the Blessed One.’
sn35.98:2.2: There are, bhikkhus, forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.98:2.3: If a bhikkhu does not seek delight in them, does not welcome them, and does not remain holding to them, he should understand this thus:
sn35.98:2.4: ‘I am not declining away from wholesome states.
sn35.98:2.5: For this has been called nondecline by the Blessed One.’
sn35.98:2.6: “There are, bhikkhus, sounds cognizable by the ear …
sn35.98:2.7: mental phenomena cognizable by the mind that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.98:2.8: If a bhikkhu does not seek delight in them, does not welcome them, and does not remain holding to them, he should understand this thus:
sn35.98:2.9: ‘I am not declining away from wholesome states.
sn35.98:2.10: For this has been called nondecline by the Blessed One.’
